    nhom_du_lieu, stt_chuyen_de::text AS stt_chuyen_de, chuyen_de, ma_chi_so, thu_tu_chi_so::text AS thu_tu_chi_so,
    ten_chi_so, ten_ngan, don_vi_tinh, loai_chi_so, (giam_la_tot::int)::text AS giam_la_tot,
    nguong::text AS nguong, ten_nguong, dau_moi, phan_to, nguon_so_lieu, ghi_chu, thong_tin_them,
    ky, thu_tu_ky::text AS thu_tu_ky, ma_ky::text AS ma_ky,
    gia_tri::text AS gia_tri, tu_so::text AS tu_so, mau_so::text AS mau_so, co_so_lieu::text AS co_so_lieu, don_vi,
    to_char(sync_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS sync_date_eform,

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`bcd57_thidiem_trienkhai_thang` (khoa, ma_don_vi, ten_don_vi, tt_don_vi, khoi, ma_ky, loai_ky, nhan_ky, ten_ky, stt_ky, han_nop, den_han, ts_nhap_dau, ts_gui_duyet, ts_phat_hanh, trang_thai, o_kiem_dem, so_bieu, so_bieu_hoan_tat, so_lan_tra_lai, lech_han_phut, moc_chup, thieu_du_lieu, sync_date)
SELECT MD5(CONCAT(x.ma_don_vi, '|', x.ma_ky)) AS khoa,
  x.ma_don_vi,
  x.ten_don_vi,
  x.tt_don_vi,
  x.khoi,
  x.ma_ky,
  x.loai_ky,
  x.nhan_ky,
  x.ten_ky,
  x.stt_ky,
  x.han_nop,
  x.den_han,
  x.ts_nhap_dau,
  x.ts_gui_duyet,
  x.ts_phat_hanh,
  x.trang_thai,
  x.o_kiem_dem,
  x.so_bieu,
  x.so_bieu_hoan_tat,
  x.so_lan_tra_lai,
  x.lech_han_phut,
  x.moc_chup,
  NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(',', IF(x.han_nop IS NULL, 'han_nop', NULL), IF(x.den_han IS NULL, 'den_han', NULL), IF(x.ts_nhap_dau IS NULL, 'ts_nhap_dau', NULL), IF(x.ts_gui_duyet IS NULL, 'ts_gui_duyet', NULL), IF(x.ts_phat_hanh IS NULL, 'ts_phat_hanh', NULL), IF(x.trang_thai IS NULL, 'trang_thai', NULL), IF(x.so_bieu IS NULL, 'so_bieu', NULL), IF(x.so_lan_tra_lai IS NULL, 'so_lan_tra_lai', NULL), IF(x.lech_han_phut IS NULL, 'lech_han_phut', NULL), IF(x.moc_chup IS NULL, 'moc_chup', NULL)), '') AS thieu_du_lieu,
  '${sync_ts}' AS sync_date
FROM (
SELECT
  dv.don_vi                                                           AS ma_don_vi,
  dv.ten                                                              AS ten_don_vi,
  dv.tt                                                               AS tt_don_vi,
  dv.khoi                                                             AS khoi,
  k.ma_ky                                                             AS ma_ky,
  'Kỳ tháng'                                                          AS loai_ky,
  CONCAT('T', k.ky)                                                   AS nhan_ky,
  CONCAT('Báo cáo tháng ', k.ky)                                      AS ten_ky,
  k.stt                                                               AS stt_ky,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR)                                                  AS han_nop,
  CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                                AS den_han,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR)                                                  AS ts_nhap_dau,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR)                                                  AS ts_gui_duyet,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR)                                                  AS ts_phat_hanh,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR)                                                  AS trang_thai,
  IF(n.so_phan > 0, 'da_nop', 'chua_nop')                             AS o_kiem_dem,
  CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                                AS so_bieu,
  IFNULL(n.so_phan, 0)                                                AS so_bieu_hoan_tat,
  CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                                AS so_lan_tra_lai,
  CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                                AS lech_han_phut,
  (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(sync_date), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') FROM datamart_hanoi.nq57_eform_chuyen_de) AS moc_chup
FROM (
  SELECT d.don_vi,
         CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(d.t, 1)), SUBSTRING(d.t, 2))               AS ten,
         IF(d.t LIKE 'phường%', 'Phường', 'Xã')                       AS khoi,
         IF(d.t LIKE 'phường%', 1, 2)                                 AS tt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT don_vi, TRIM(REPLACE(don_vi, 'Thường trực BCĐ57', '')) AS t
        FROM datamart_hanoi.nq57_eform_chuyen_de WHERE don_vi IS NOT NULL) d
) dv
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT a.ky, a.ma_ky, a.thu_tu_ky,
         (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.thu_tu_ky) FROM datamart_hanoi.nq57_eform_chuyen_de b
           WHERE b.don_vi IS NOT NULL AND b.thu_tu_ky <= a.thu_tu_ky)  AS stt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ky, ma_ky, thu_tu_ky FROM datamart_hanoi.nq57_eform_chuyen_de WHERE don_vi IS NOT NULL) a
) k
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT don_vi, ma_ky, COUNT(DISTINCT nhom_du_lieu) AS so_phan
  FROM datamart_hanoi.nq57_eform_chuyen_de
  WHERE nhom_du_lieu IN ('NOI_DUNG_XA', 'DIEM_NGHEN_XA') AND don_vi IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY don_vi, ma_ky
) n ON n.don_vi = dv.don_vi AND n.ma_ky = k.ma_ky
) x
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  ma_don_vi = VALUES(ma_don_vi),
  ten_don_vi = VALUES(ten_don_vi),
  tt_don_vi = VALUES(tt_don_vi),
  khoi = VALUES(khoi),
  ma_ky = VALUES(ma_ky),
  loai_ky = VALUES(loai_ky),
  nhan_ky = VALUES(nhan_ky),
  ten_ky = VALUES(ten_ky),
  stt_ky = VALUES(stt_ky),
  han_nop = VALUES(han_nop),
  den_han = VALUES(den_han),
  ts_nhap_dau = VALUES(ts_nhap_dau),
  ts_gui_duyet = VALUES(ts_gui_duyet),
  ts_phat_hanh = VALUES(ts_phat_hanh),
  trang_thai = VALUES(trang_thai),
  o_kiem_dem = VALUES(o_kiem_dem),
  so_bieu = VALUES(so_bieu),
  so_bieu_hoan_tat = VALUES(so_bieu_hoan_tat),
  so_lan_tra_lai = VALUES(so_lan_tra_lai),
  lech_han_phut = VALUES(lech_han_phut),
  moc_chup = VALUES(moc_chup),
  thieu_du_lieu = VALUES(thieu_du_lieu),
  sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);
DELETE FROM `datamart_hanoi`.`bcd57_thidiem_trienkhai_thang`
WHERE sync_date < '${sync_ts}'
  AND (SELECT z.n FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM `datamart_hanoi`.`bcd57_thidiem_trienkhai_thang` WHERE sync_date = '${sync_ts}') z) > 0
